Help/Fixing a capture/No depth readings

The capture has no depth readings

The capture has no depth readings, so a 3D walkthrough cannot be built. Capture on an iPhone or iPad with LiDAR (a Pro model), so every photo has depth.

  1. Check the device: an iPhone 12 Pro or a later Pro model, or an iPad Pro with LiDAR. In the app, Account says "Ready to capture" on a device that can record.
  2. Make sure nothing covers the rear cameras or the LiDAR sensor beside them: no case edge, finger or dirt.
  3. Capture the room again with Veylet Capture, then send it.

If it doesn’t work

If Account says the device has no rear LiDAR camera, that device cannot record a capture. See what you need.

Recapturing won’t use a walkthrough.

Still stuck? Email Veylet support

Write to yoda@yodalai.xyz and a person replies. Say which step you were on, your iPhone or iPad model, and the app version from Account, then About. Never send passwords or sign-in links.
